edges.reason: Constructor assigns the governor role from msg.sender, granting privileged control.
onlyGovernor modifier requires msg.sender == governor before setGovernor executes.
onlyGovernor modifier gates the one-time setLimit proto limit configuration.
onlyGovernor modifier gates the addition of new approved CardPack contracts.
transfer requires owns(msg.sender, id) before moving the card.
transferFrom requires the caller be owner, approved spender or operator.
createCard is restricted by onlyApprovedPacks comparing msg.sender to the pack list.
mint requires msg.sender be present in the minters array.
Vault.withdraw is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
CappedVault.withdraw is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
msg.sender is stored as the user of the new Purchase struct.
TournamentPass purchase credits balances and emits Transfer for msg.sender.
msg.sender is written into the purchases array entry.
Constructor writes the governor state variable.
setGovernor reassigns the governor address, transferring full privilege.
_addProto performs an unchecked protoCount increment.
protoCount state variable is incremented without overflow protection.
_addProto writes the supplied ProtoCard into the protos mapping.
createCard decrements the mythic limit of the proto being minted.
limits mapping entry is decremented and can be driven to wrap or misaccount.
createCard delegates actual minting to the internal _createCard routine.
_createCard pushes a new Card struct into the cards array.
_createCard calls _transfer/ownership assignment for the new token.
_addToken appends the token id into ownedTokens for the recipient.
_addToken records the new position into the indices array.
_transfer overwrites the owners mapping for the token id.
_transfer resets the single-token approval for the id.
_transfer adds the token to the recipient's owned token list.
_transfer removes the token from the sender's owned token list.
lastIndex is computed as ownedTokens length minus one and underflows for empty lists.
Local index read from indices is used to overwrite the removed slot.
_removeToken mutates ownedTokens using a stale index-derived position.
burn routes the token to the zero address through the internal _transfer.
burn increments burnCount without overflow checking.
transferFrom delegates approval validation to isSenderApprovedFor.
isSenderApprovedFor reads the approved and operators mappings.
approve writes the approved spender for a token id.
safeTransferFrom performs the underlying transferFrom call.
safeTransferFrom calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract after transferring.
extcodesize determines whether the recipient callback path is taken.
purchase sends the referral commission to an arbitrary address before finishing accounting.
purchase forwards the remaining price to the vault through a transfer call.
Commission value flows to the caller supplied referrer address.
purchase derives the price using calculatePrice before requiring msg.value.
Price decay depends on block.number minus creationBlock arithmetic.
purchase forwards ETH to the configured vault address.
callback derives the randomness seed from blockhash of the commit block.
callback accumulates the purchase count into totalCount unchecked.
totalCount is used both as randomness entropy and as an unbounded counter.
callback writes the resulting randomness back into the Purchase storage entry.
claim advances the purchase current counter without overflow checking.
claim mints cards by repeatedly calling integration.createCard.
claim is gated by the owner-controlled canClaim flag.
setCanClaim lets the owner enable or disable all claims.
Derived randomness components feed getRandomCard for proto selection.
ShinyLegendaryPack.purchase delegates to the base PresalePack.purchase.
Shiny pack purchase mints tournament passes for the buyer.
getCardDetails queries integration.getRandomCard for the proto id.
getCardDetails obtains randomness components from getComponents.
mint increases total supply subject to mintLimit.
mint credits the recipient balance.
transfer debits and credits balances.
transfer relies on SafeMath add/sub for checked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements the allowance matrix.
Pass purchase forwards msg.value to the vault.
Pass purchase increases supply by the purchased amount.
Vault.withdraw performs an external value transfer to the owner address.
External transfer sends the balance to the owner address.
CappedVault.withdraw transfers value before updating its accounting state.
withdrawn is incremented after the external call, allowing inconsistent accounting.
Cap accounting depends on the withdrawn counter that can be manipulated mid-call.
Fallback enforces total() + msg.value <= limit using balance and withdrawn.
nextSeason performs an unchecked increment of the season counter.
currentSeason wraps past 255 even though the require guard is always true.
pause flips the paused flag to true.
unpause flips the paused flag back to false.
makeUntradable refuses to act on locked seasons.
makeUntradable disables tradability for a season.
makePermanantlyTradable requires tradability then locks the season.
withdraw amount parameter controls the external transfer value.
transfer id selects which card is moved.
packCount scales the required price and stored purchase size.
externalID keys the existence check and proto storage write.
Local price value is used for msg.value comparison and vault payment.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only supplies the new privileged governor address written by setGovernor.
Card id parameter only selects the token handled by transfer.
Recipient parameter only flows into the transfer ownership update.
Sender parameter is only checked against ownerOf inside transferFrom.
Card id parameter only selects the token handled by transferFrom.
Amount parameter only bounds and funds the external transfer in withdraw.
packCount only scales price, minted passes and stored purchase count.
Referrer parameter directly feeds the external commission transfer.
Purchase id parameter only selects the storage entry updated by callback.
externalID only keys the existence check and protos mapping write.
ProtoCard memory parameter is copied into protos storage by _addProto.
Owner parameter only becomes the recipient of the newly created card.
Proto parameter selects the Card struct and mythic limit decremented.
Purity parameter is only embedded into the created Card struct.
Rarity parameter only chooses which proto array is indexed.
Random parameter is only used with modulo against array lengths.
Local price controls the msg.value requirement and vault payment in purchase.
Local commission value is the amount sent by the external referral transfer.
Local blockhash entropy is the source of the weak on-chain randomness.
Local randomness value is only stored on the Purchase entry by callback.
Storage pointer p is only used to mutate the Purchase inside callback.
Local index only selects the ownedTokens slot rewritten by _removeToken.
Local lastIndex drives the unchecked length-1 removal arithmetic.
Local pos is only pushed into the indices array by _addToken.
Local end only bounds the card creation loop inside claim.
Local rarity copy only routes the proto into the rarity arrays in _addProto.
